statement: For every rational toric pair (a,b), the inherited cubic class-two pro-3 section fibre is empty exactly when some tame residue has 3-primary order greater than9, and otherwise consists of precisely three classes, with explicit central twists j(chi_3²−1)/3.
notes: Uses an actual integral Steinberg cup-nullhomotopy from rational-point sections; K2(Q) tame-symbol exact sequence; explicit local continuous-cohomology residue detecting its3-primary subgroup. Avoids asserting global H² injectivity into its finite coefficient limit. H¹(Q,Z3(2)) is computed asZ/3 using inertia and the opened Hain–Matsumoto even-weight theorem. Exact intrinsic→inherited quotient map is stated; this is a complete rational-pair classification for the inherited quotient, with no assertion of intrinsic rank-ten or arbitrary completed-pair classification.
